name: How Computers Count Quiz
description: Eleven questions about bits, bytes and binary, for curious people.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eleven multiple-choice questions about bits, bytes and binary, shown on Quick Quiz.
help.goal: Just for fun. Answer what you like; your score is shown only to you.
howToPlay: Read the question and choose an answer.
A short explanation follows each answer.
Press Next question to carry on.
At the end, Play again gives a fresh shuffle.
tips: No need to know any of this beforehand. The explanations teach as you go.
